services.name: Youth Curling in Parry Sound
services.desc: Parry Sound, a town steeped in history and tradition, is set to celebrate a significant milestone - 125 years of curling excellence. This landmark achievement calls for a grand exhibition that pays homage to the rich heritage of this beloved sport in the heart of Ontario. The exhibition will be a captivating journey through time, tracing the roots of curling in Parry Sound. From its humble beginnings on natural ice to the state-of-the-art facilities of today, visitors will witness the evolution of a sport that has become deeply woven into the fabric of the community.
